description:
This video is about "How Big is Godrej Group?🔥 The Untold History & Business Empire | Family Split | Live Hindi"

The Godrej Group, established in 1897, has grown into one of India's largest and most diversified business conglomerates. It began with Godrej & Boyce Manufacturing Company Limited, producing locks and safes, and evolved into a business empire spanning sectors like consumer goods, real estate, agriculture, and defense technology.

The group’s journey is shaped by key people like Adi Godrej, who transformed the group into a global powerhouse, Nadir Godrej, who expanded Godrej’s operations into chemicals and real estate, and Jamshyd Godrej, who pioneered innovations in manufacturing. The leadership also includes Pirojsha Godrej, who led the real estate arm, Nisaba Godrej, who revolutionized consumer products, and Pirojsha Adi Godrej, continuing the family legacy in the modern world.

However, the Godrej Group's history hasn’t been without challenges. Internal conflicts, including the Godrej family split and the Mumbai land dispute, tested the family’s unity but didn’t stop the group’s rise. Despite these hurdles, the company adapted and emerged stronger, continuing to innovate and expand.

Today, Godrej has a global presence, with key companies like Godrej Industries Limited, Godrej & Boyce Manufacturing, Godrej Consumer Products, Godrej Agrovet, and Godrej Properties. The group also excels in aerospace with Godrej Aerospace and information technology through Godrej Infotech.

The Godrej Group is a testament to vision, innovation, and resilience. From humble beginnings to becoming a major player in various industries, it remains a cornerstone of India’s business landscape.
